definitions.explanation: One of the small leaf-like segments that together form the calyx of a flower. Sepals wrap the bud before it opens and usually stay attached, green and inconspicuous, behind the petals.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{萼片|がくへん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緑色|みどりいろ}→緑色：24190_midoriiro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目立|めだ}たない→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: The sepals of this flower are green and inconspicuous.

examples.japanese: {萼片|がくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧きた。
examples.english: When the sepals opened, white petals came into view inside.

notes:
A botanical term, used in textbooks and plant descriptions rather than everyday conversation. The individual segment is the {萼片|がくへん}; the whole ring of them is the ⟦{萼|がく}→萼：30519_gaku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {萼片|がくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: the sepals open
- {萼片|がくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: the sepals drop off
- ⟦{緑色|みどりいろ}→緑色：24190_midoriiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{萼片|がくへん}: green sepals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{萼|がく}→萼：30519_gaku⟧: calyx — the sepals taken together as one structure
- ⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧: petal — the colorful segment inside the sepals
